bad_default_role: meeting_attendance_default must be off, listener or participant.
forbidden: This device can’t do this. Use a device with full access.
too_large: The request is too large: at most {size}.
no_recording: There is no upload of this recording yet. Upload it, then send again.
bad_from: from must be a whole number, 0 or more.
bad_time: Each sentence’s start and end must be numbers.
live_gap: Sentences are missing before this one. Send again from {next}.
live_full: This recording has all the live sentences it can keep. Send no more for it.
no_question: Send a question, or the time you tapped (at).
op_id_reused: This id was already used for another question.
ask_busy: Two questions are being answered now. Ask again once one is answered.
meeting_ended: This meeting has ended. Write in its follow-up instead.
bad_private: private must be true or false.
meeting_running: The meeting is still going on. Write in its follow-up once it has ended.
no_material: This recording has neither a transcript nor minutes to talk about.
just_me_notify: Not sent: you asked this privately during a meeting. Your answer stays in this conversation, which the meeting page shows.
bad_photo_at: at must be a number: the seconds from the start of the recording when the photo was taken.
bad_photo_mime: mime must be image/jpeg or image/png.
bad_photo_data: data must be a base64 JPEG or PNG image of the type mime names.
photo_too_wide: A photo is at most {max} pixels on its long side.
transcript_expired: This recording’s transcript has expired; only its minutes are kept.
photo_not_found: This meeting has no such photo.
photo_deleted: This photo was deleted, so it can’t be added again.
photo_id_reused: This id was already used for another photo.
